passages.heading: Missing material report
passages.text: Synthetic field report: A crew member flags a missing material item against a job. The office reviews the blocker and can prepare a response. This example does not send or acknowledge anything.

passages.heading: Estimate and actual cost comparison
passages.text: Synthetic owner review: Compare an accepted estimate with recorded labor and material costs. Missing rates, scope changes and billing evidence remain unknown until verified. Do not claim a loss, invoice or payment from this example.
